Ice Jewel Blast provides a Weekly/Monthly/Yearly VIP card subscription. 
VIP Card offers different subscriptions, and you will be charged $3.99/$12.99/$99.99 for the Weekly/Monthly/Yearly service. After buying the subscription, you will unlock following features: 
1. Claim 100 gold everyday! 
2. During the subscription period, the 100 gold will be preserved when you miss them! 
3. You can claim 200 preserved golds everyday at most
4. No pop-up ads!            

Subscription Notice: 
1. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
2. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
3. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. 
4. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. 
5. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

The ICE2U app will allow you to purchase ice within the app and earn reward points towards free ice at all participating Twice the Ice and Partner locations.  Load your app with funds, visit a participating machine and vend your bag of Ice right from the app without ever having to touch the machine.  For every 10 bags purchased you will get 1 bag for free.  Find the nearest Twice The Ice vending machine from your current location and get driving directions right from the app.  Twice the Ice locations provide fresh bagged ice 24/7 and fresh filtered or purified water a participating locations.  A Healthy lifestyle starts with fresh products.  Twice the Ice ensures that you are receiving fresh, high quality ice & water any time of day.  Now you can use a convenient App to find the TTI in your community so you can taste the difference.

You are the Ice Man. With your awesome power over the elements, you have everything you need to make the bad guys chill! Become the icy superhero, and protect the city from the thugs who threaten it. Freeze your enemies with your icy super powers, and shatter them to satisfying pieces with your bare hands! You don’t need a weapon to show them who’s the boss.
 
Unlock tons of new superpowers and prove your strength to anyone foolish enough to challenge  you! All the power you need is right in your hands but you will need to think quickly and use the best strategy to shoot, freeze and destroy your enemies before they can get to you! Become a sub-zero master of ice and make sure no one can get past your freezing touch!
 
Be the Ice Master! 
Freeze your enemies and shatter them to tiny bits before time runs out. Being the hero has never been this fun! 

 Lots of Cool Powers
Unlock the coolest superpowers. Begin with your Ice Beam and upgrade to Frost Nova, Blizzard, Frozen Hand and more.

Easy Freezy!
With easy to learn controls, you’ll have so much fun blasting your enemies with the powers of ice, but don’t be fooled, each new level brings new challenges for you to overcome!   
 
Satisfying 3D 
Unleash the wrath of the elements in stunning 3D. It looks so real, you’ll wonder why your mobile hasn’t frozen over!
